profile.headline: AI/ML Infra @Google DeepMind
profile.summary:
A software engineer with a PhD in computer science.

Specialties:  Large-scale infra,  Distributed systems, AI/ML, Test automation,  SaaS, Networking

Working on Large Scale Developer Infrastructure at F5 Networks. 

Worked on Cruise self-driving cars, Apple's AI/ML and Google's core infrastructure and tooling. Built TAP, the world’s largest distributed Continuous Integration system used by all Google products including Search, Ads, Cloud, Android, Youtube.

Founding member Google Software Engineering Journal Club: https://sites.google.com/site/gjournalclub

Founded the GUITAR project, an open-source model-based GUI software testing framework.

Academic research: Organizing Committees of  Google Test Automation Conference (GTAC) and International Conference on Software Testing (ICST). Reviewer for top academic SE journals and conferences

Academic website:  https://sites.google.com/view/baonn

positions.title: Architect
positions.description: Led F5's BIG-IP Next internal infrastructure development

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built ML infrastructure for autonomous vehicle development at scale.

Tech lead for Prediction team - building ML components  to understand the environment and  predict behaviors of actors around the autonomous vehicle.

positions.title: Siri - Senior Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
One of the first engineers enabling Siri and other AI/ML components on Apple's Vision Pro. 
* Architect and build infrastructure/automation for Vision Pro on its early days. 
* Define overall engineering workflow and best practices
* Build large-scale ML evaluation platforms for Siri integration on all Apple's hardwares (including the unreleased ones)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on Google-wide engineering tooling and infrastructure
* Led a team to re-architect Google CI system (TAP) to horizontally scale with 45k engineers and 40M test targets in a 3B LOC mono-repo 
* Rewrote Google's global test scheduler and test selection algorithms 
* Reduced average test execution time in entire Google CI by 30% 
* Optimized overall resource consumption by 30%

Founding member Google Software Engineering Journal Club

Hiring Committee

projects.title: Guitar
projects.description: GUITAR is  a model-based system for automated testing GUI-based applications. It works on multiple GUI platform such as Web, Swing, Android, iOS and detects many real bugs on popular open-source applications.

projects.title: Maryland Dozen
projects.description: Build and set up a cloud-based infrastructure to conduct large scale, continuous empirical software engineering experiments.

publications.title: Taming Google-Scale Continuous Testing
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 39th International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2017) · May 1, 2017

publications.title: An Observe-Model-Exercise* Paradigm to Test Event-Driven Systems with Undetermined Input Spaces
publications.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering · Mar 1, 2014
